description: Look up a port in the NGA World Port Index by name, UN/LOCODE, or WPI number. Returns WPI number, coordinates, harbor size/type, channel/anchorage/cargo-pier depths, and facilities. Refuses with an error if nothing matches.

name.description: Port name, e.g. "Rotterdam" (exact match preferred, falls back to substring)

wpi_number.description: NGA World Port Index port number, e.g. 31140

name: port_lookup
